AndroidX Graphics Path 1.0.1 — native source notices

Artifact: androidx.graphics:graphics-path:1.0.1
Project: https://developer.android.com/jetpack/androidx/releases/graphics
Source revision linked by the official 1.0.1 release notes:
8a05a22af450d589ef911d772a001a49dcb05b71
Native source directory:
https://android.googlesource.com/platform/frameworks/support/+/8a05a22af450d589ef911d772a001a49dcb05b71/graphics/graphics-path/src/main/cpp/

The native wrapper and its included math helpers carry the Apache License 2.0
notices reproduced below. They query Android's system graphics implementation;
this artifact does not bundle the full Skia graphics engine. The Apache License
2.0 text is supplied separately with the application's open-source licenses.
These are upstream notices; Natsuko has not modified the published AAR.
